case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Gardener Interview Name Caption
tests: Checks an exact two-line lower third that stays readable and correctly placed over a moving subject.

faults.what: The supplied sound report indicates music or ambience at a peak of -26 dB, so the delivered clip is not silent.
The lower third is already fully visible at 0.9 seconds, before the requested text-free opening second has ended.

judge.summary: The garden portrait and readable lower third meet the visual brief, but the clip includes unwanted audio and the caption appears slightly early.

must_haves.item: A woman is visibly in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera.
must_haves.why: The frames show a smiling woman among raised garden beds, turning from a side view toward the camera.

must_haves.item: The lower third reads exactly 'Maya Chen' above 'Community Gardener', with no additional text.
must_haves.why: Both requested lines are spelled correctly and no other text is visible.

must_haves.item: Both lines use legible white lettering on a dark backing at the bottom left, with no clipping.
must_haves.why: Both lines are clearly readable in white on a dark rectangular backing at the bottom left, with all lettering inside the frame.

must_haves.item: The lower third does not cover her face and remains stable and readable as she moves.
must_haves.why: Its placement and text remain consistent across the supplied frames, well below her face.

must_haves.item: The caption is absent during the opening second and present from approximately second 1 through the end.
must_haves.why: It is already fully visible at 0.9 seconds; it remains visible in all subsequent supplied frames, including at 6.4 seconds.

must_haves.item: The delivered clip is silent, 16:9 and approximately 7 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The frames are widescreen 16:9 and the reported duration is approximately seven seconds, but the sound report identifies non-silent music or ambience.
